_comment: Tunables for the AGENTIC signature family (AGT-01..AGT-09) evaluated by scripts/osint/signature_scan.py and described in analysis/signature-catalog.md. Thresholds and patterns ONLY — no case data. A fired AGT signature identifies TOOLING (kit rung), never the human operator or sponsor (RULE 5): never an add_edge, never operator_lead. Patterns are Python regexes matched case-insensitively.

thresholds._comment: Edit here, not in code. Times: *_ms milliseconds, *_s seconds, *_min minutes.

library_user_agents._comment: Default HTTP-library / CLI user agents — what agent frameworks send when nobody sets a UA.

headless_user_agents._comment: Headless / automation browsers an agent drives for JS-heavy steps.

declared_agent_user_agents._comment: Self-declared AI agent / assistant fetchers. Declared and usually legitimate — counted as a mix signal only, never alone.

llm_artefact_patterns._comment: Assistant prose leaking into payloads, comments, form fields or log lines.

tool_call_patterns._comment: Tool-call / function-call JSON or agent-protocol fragments in logs or payloads.
